decisions.reason: The passenger data transmission solution has government customers and connects to over 30 APIS schemes, so it remains a core, revenue-generating offer.
Pandemic-era demand for travel health requirements has faded, but the API still feeds the firm's document verification and airline compliance services at low maintenance cost.
The cyber security awareness module is cheap to run, fits the firm's certified training business and sells into a growing compliance market.
Behaviour analysis draws on the firm's aviation security expertise and supports its strategy of combining technology with trained personnel.
Passenger security profiling is a long-standing competence embedded in the firm's airport and airline services.
The travel and document verification platform has its own page and serves ongoing airline compliance needs close to the firm's core offer.
